home.heroTitle:
Come and Taste the
Goodness of God
home.heroSubtitle: A community of believers gathering in the mountains of Lebanon, seeking God together through His Word, worship, and love.
home.heroVerse: "Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the one who takes refuge in him." — Psalm 34:8
home.welcomeText: Nestled in the beautiful mountain town of Bikfaya, we are a warm, gospel-centered family. Whether you are searching for truth, returning to faith, or growing as a believer, there is a place for you here. We gather to worship, learn, and love — and we would love for you to be part of our story.
home.gospelTitle: Know the God Who Loves You
home.gospelText: The Bible tells us that God created us for a relationship with Him. Though sin has separated us, God sent His Son Jesus Christ to restore what was broken. Through faith in Christ alone, you can be forgiven, reconciled to God, and given eternal life.

jesus.heroSubtitle: The Son of God, the Saviour of the world, the Lord of all — and the greatest story ever told.
jesus.whoText: Jesus of Nazareth is unlike any figure in history. The Bible reveals Him as the eternal Son of God who took on human flesh, born of a virgin in Bethlehem. He lived a perfect life, performed undeniable miracles, and fulfilled hundreds of ancient prophecies. He is not merely a teacher or a prophet — He is God incarnate, the Word who was in the beginning.
jesus.verseJohn: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God."
jesus.step1Text: God is perfectly righteous and just. He cannot overlook sin — every act of rebellion against Him carries the weight of eternal consequence.
jesus.step2Text: Every human being has sinned and fallen short of God's glory. On our own, we are separated from God with no way to bridge that gap.
jesus.step3Text: In extraordinary love, God sent His Son Jesus to live the life we couldn't live and to die the death we deserved. He bore our sins on the cross and rose from the dead, defeating death itself.
jesus.step4Text: Salvation is a free gift received through faith — trusting in Jesus alone, turning from sin, and surrendering your life to Him as Lord.
jesus.verseRomans: "For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life."
jesus.prayerText: If you are ready to place your trust in Jesus Christ, you can pray from your heart right now. God hears every sincere prayer.
jesus.prayerSample: "Lord Jesus, I know I am a sinner. I believe You died for my sins and rose from the dead. I turn from my sin and place my trust in You alone as my Lord and Saviour. Come into my life and make me new. Amen."

about.heroTitle:
Rooted in Faith,
Raised in Lebanon
about.heroSubtitle: A Baptist congregation committed to the Word of God, the glory of Christ, and the flourishing of our community.
about.beliefsIntro: We hold to the 1689 London Baptist Confession of Faith as a faithful summary of biblical teaching. These are the doctrines we teach, preach, and live by.
about.lf1Text: The Holy Scripture is the only sufficient, certain, and infallible rule of all saving knowledge, faith, and obedience. The authority of Scripture depends not upon the testimony of any man or church, but wholly upon God its author, who is truth itself. The whole counsel of God concerning all things necessary for His own glory, man's salvation, faith, and life, is either expressly set down or necessarily contained in the Holy Scripture.
about.lf2Title: Chapter 2 — Of God and of the Holy Trinity
about.lf2Text: The Lord our God is but one only living and true God; whose subsistence is in and of Himself, infinite in being and perfection. In this divine and infinite Being there are three subsistences: the Father, the Word (or Son), and the Holy Spirit, of one substance, power, and eternity.
about.lf3Text: God has decreed in Himself, from all eternity, by the most wise and holy counsel of His own will, freely and unchangeably, all things that come to pass; yet in such a way that God is neither the author of sin nor has fellowship with any therein.
about.lf4Text: In the beginning it pleased God the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, for the manifestation of the glory of His eternal power, wisdom, and goodness, to create or make the world, and all things therein, whether visible or invisible, in the space of six days, and all very good.
about.lf5Text: God the good Creator of all things, in His infinite power and wisdom, upholds, directs, disposes, and governs all creatures and things, from the greatest even to the least, by His most holy, most wise, and most powerful providence.
about.lf6Title: Chapter 6 — Of the Fall of Man, of Sin, and of the Punishment Thereof
about.lf6Text: Although God created man upright and perfect, and gave him a righteous law, which had been unto life had he kept it, Adam and Eve fell from their original righteousness and communion with God. By this sin they, and we in them, became dead in sin, and wholly defiled in all the faculties and parts of soul and body.
about.lf14Text: The grace of faith, whereby the elect are enabled to believe to the saving of their souls, is the work of the Spirit of Christ in their hearts. By this faith a Christian believes to be true whatsoever is revealed in the Word, for the authority of God Himself; acting differently upon that which each particular passage thereof contains.
about.lf29Text: Baptism is an ordinance of the New Testament, ordained by Jesus Christ. It is to be administered to those who do actually profess repentance towards God and faith in and obedience to our Lord Jesus Christ. Being immersed in water.
about.hist1Text: A small group of believers begins gathering in Bikfaya for prayer and Bible study, planting the seeds of what would become our church.
about.hist2Text: Bikfaya Baptist Church is formally constituted as a congregation with its first baptisms and the adoption of our Baptist confession of faith.
about.hist3Text: Through Lebanon's civil war, the church remains a beacon of hope and refuge, continuing to preach the gospel amid great hardship.
about.hist4Text: A newly constructed sanctuary is dedicated to the glory of God, providing the congregation a permanent home in the heart of Bikfaya.
about.hist5Text: Youth ministries, women's Bible study, and outreach programs are formally launched, deepening the church's gospel impact in the region.
about.hist6Text: We continue to gather, grow, and go — committed to the gospel, the whole counsel of God, and the flourishing of Lebanon and beyond.

community.heroSubtitle: God is gathering together a people from all walks of life, bringing us into the light of His Son. The most beautiful way we get to celebrate this community is with one another each Sunday. We'd love you to join us.
community.youthText: Our youth ministry exists to see the next generation meet Jesus Christ personally and be equipped to live for Him in all of life. We meet every Saturday at 6pm for worship, teaching, and real community. Contact our Youth Pastor Rick for more details.
community.bibleText: Throughout the week we gather in homes to read God's Word together. These groups are a great opportunity to get to know others better, whether you're new to Jesus or you've been following him for years. Contact Pastor Wissam for more details.
community.noEvents: No upcoming events. Check back soon!

joinUs.heroSubtitle: Come as you are. You'll find open hearts, warm community, and the life-giving Word of God.
joinUs.sundayNote: Main worship service with teaching and communion (first Sunday monthly)
joinUs.sundaySchoolNote: Classes for all ages before the main service
joinUs.youthNote: For teens and young adults — contact Rick for details
joinUs.expect1Text: From the moment you arrive, you'll be greeted by friendly faces. No dress code, no pressure — just a genuine welcome.
joinUs.expect2Text: We sing hymns and contemporary songs of praise, accompanied by a small worship team. Expect heartfelt, unhurried worship.
joinUs.expect3Text: Our sermons are expository — we work through books of the Bible verse-by-verse, applying God's timeless truth to our lives today.
joinUs.expect4Text: After each service, we gather for coffee and conversation. This is where real relationships begin — and where you'll find your place.
joinUs.familiesText: We have dedicated Sunday School classes for children and teens, so every member of your family can grow in faith. Nursing mothers have a private space available. Your children are a joy to us.
joinUs.faq1Q: Do I need to be baptized to attend?
joinUs.faq1A: Not at all! Everyone is welcome to attend our services regardless of their background or church history. We'd love to meet you wherever you are in your journey.
joinUs.faq2Q: What translation of the Bible do you use?
joinUs.faq2A: We primarily use the English Standard Version (ESV) for preaching, and we provide printed outlines. We also have Arabic Bibles available.
joinUs.faq3A: Yes, there is street parking around the church, and a nearby community lot is available on Sunday mornings.
joinUs.faq4Q: Do you have programs for children?
joinUs.faq4A: Yes! We offer Sunday School classes for children from ages 3 through high school during the 9:30 AM hour, as well as a youth group on Friday evenings.
joinUs.faq5Q: Can I visit without committing to membership?
joinUs.faq5A: Absolutely. We encourage people to visit, explore, and ask questions freely. There is no obligation whatsoever — our doors are always open.
joinUs.faq6Q: Do you offer services in Arabic?
joinUs.faq6A: Our Sunday morning service is conducted primarily in English with Arabic translation available. We also have Arabic-language materials and Bibles.

contact.heroSubtitle: Whether you have questions, need prayer, or just want to say hello — we're here.
contact.successText: Thank you for reaching out. We'll get back to you within 1–2 business days.
contact.prayerText: We believe in the power of prayer. Share your request and our pastoral team will lift you before God in prayer.
contact.prayerSuccess: Your prayer request has been received. Our team is praying for you.
